text: APPROVE. The extraction preserves the original check order and the early-return semantics (the version pattern `is { Length: > 0 } text` is the correct inversion of the old `is not`), and it leaves the loop in `ReadPackageLock` with one `if`, which brings it well under 15. The new helper scores about 7, and the target-typed ternary compiles under C# 9+. I could not see the full file, so I'm assuming nullable reference types are enabled, which `NpmLockedPackage?` needs to build without a warning-as-error.
